Four comments

Buckley’s Fancy

I don’t like the submitted transcription very much. The transcriber has tried to save time and energy but has only ended up missing important bits of the tune in the B-part.

Here’s a simplified transcription of how it appears on Dervish’s Playing With Fire:

X: 1
T: Buckley’s Fancy
M: 4/4
L: 1/8
R: reel
K: Gmaj
G2BG dGBG|c3d efgz|G2BG dGBG|ABAG FA (3DEF|
G2BG dGBG|c3d efga|bgga gedB|1 GBAF GBdB:|2 GBAF GABd||
|:~g3a gede|g2bg ageg|~a3b ageg|agbg agef|
~g3a gede|g2bg agef|~g3a gedB|1 GBAF GABd:|2 GBAF GBdB||

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on December 30th, 2004.
